qualification: All cases are planned. Package checks are not executions of these product cases. Live GPU/model cases require current explicit resource/authority grants.

cases.title: Candidate source, not ambient deployment
cases.setup: Run the source-mode harness with an installed sibling present.
cases.expected: Imported module paths and content hashes identify the candidate; broker/cache/artifacts are isolated; no production change.

cases.title: Replay is real orchestration, not fake product logic
cases.setup: Replay fixed visible calls/observations through production controller code.
cases.expected: Correct context, legal citations and refusal paths are checked without model inference; no claim of model quality.

cases.title: Request-only variants keep weights warm
cases.setup: Use an exclusively leased compatible real evaluation server for baseline and request-policy variants.
cases.expected: Record unchanged server identity and no full release rebuild; isolated trial state and actual effective budgets.

cases.title: Layer-specific failure diagnosis and stop rule
cases.setup: Inject protocol, source-proof, timeout and non-improving quality cases.
cases.expected: Each failure is classified correctly; finite branch/case budget and two non-improving-iteration stop are enforced in the evaluation workflow.

cases.title: Supplier dependency and consumer inventory
cases.setup: Enumerate runtime imports, policies, test/qualification entry points and active edits.
cases.expected: Hashed bounded handoff identifies preserved independent kernel/interlock/domain ownership and proposed compatibility seam.

cases.title: One implementation, baseline protocol parity
cases.setup: Exercise old compatibility imports and new receiver imports against the same fake/real protocol fixtures.
cases.expected: One canonical implementation and one owner; no duplicate pool, import cycle or permission widening.

cases.title: Release identity and incompatible source binding
cases.setup: Present absent, stale or ambient runtime packages/manifests.
cases.expected: Fail closed or park before dispatch; no relaxation of production identity for source-mode convenience.

cases.title: Preserved consumers and explicit inactive delegation
cases.setup: Exercise updated CUDA qualification/native-maintenance adapters and public tool guards.
cases.expected: Consumers resolve agreed runtime; dormant delegate tools remain absent and denied unless separately approved.

cases.title: Two parents, two children, two slots
cases.setup: Run two parents that each request bounded dependent work.
cases.expected: Both parent leases are released; children run within two slots; each parent resumes from its own results without deadlock.

cases.title: Lost wake-up and duplicate delivery
cases.setup: Complete child around parent wait registration; deliver terminal event twice.
cases.expected: Reconciliation wakes the exact parent generation once; result cannot be lost or committed twice.

cases.title: Cycle and descendant bounds
cases.setup: Submit self/cyclic waits and attempts to exceed internal credits/depth.
cases.expected: Refuse boundedly without consuming all admission capacity or losing accepted foreground roots.

cases.title: Public expiry independent of blocked execution
cases.setup: Block model/transport/tool or cleanup beyond the inquiry deadline using fake time.
cases.expected: Public inquiry terminalizes within watchdog grace from retained evidence; cleanup remains accounted until verified; retries do not extend expiry.

cases.title: Restart and late generation fence
cases.setup: Crash before/after checkpoint or outbox materialization, then supersede/cancel parent.
cases.expected: Resume only accepted visible state; late attempts cannot update current results or authority.

cases.title: Busy admission, internal children and starvation
cases.setup: Fill public capacity with roots including suspended work, then add eligible internal dependencies and foreground demand.
cases.expected: Existing public busy meaning retained; bounded child credits allow progress; automatic work cannot consume reserved demand admission.

cases.title: Frame-local budgets and isolation
cases.setup: Alternate two frames with different permitted policies and disjoint source sets.
cases.expected: Actual policy/visible context is frame-specific; no shared-global setter race, hidden-state dependence or source leakage.

cases.title: Cooperative and full eviction are distinct
cases.setup: Request foreground work and GPU release while a model turn is active.
cases.expected: Measured bounded cooperative delay is reported; no false instant release; owned-process quiescence precedes GPU handoff.

cases.title: Material freshness versus unrelated changes
cases.setup: Create a note, then change a relevant source/config and an unrelated file separately.
cases.expected: Relevant determinants invalidate; unrelated HEAD change alone does not; deleted/renamed inputs and partial coverage remain explicit.

cases.title: Retention outlives recent-answer window
cases.setup: Retain a useful note, then answer more than 50 unrelated inquiries and run retention.
cases.expected: Note-owned supporting artifacts remain pinned or are explicitly unavailable; no orphaned authoritative-looking assertion.

cases.title: Exact public cache and historical warning
cases.setup: Repeat identical and whitespace-varied questions; refresh a stale supported answer and an empty failure.
cases.expected: Exact identity and negative-cache semantics preserved; historical evidence carries freshness warning in unresolved_questions.

cases.title: Foundational evidence survives compaction
cases.setup: Force bounded context pressure after reading skill entry and decisive resources.
cases.expected: Retain required proof or re-fetch valid references; omitted/unread/truncated evidence cannot support selected excerpts.

cases.title: No self-corroboration or canonical impersonation
cases.setup: Feed model-produced notes and request automatic canonical publication.
cases.expected: Original provenance remains visible; model repetition is not new proof; publication is denied without current canonical capability.

cases.title: Trusted cross-project access
cases.setup: Retrieve evidence from multiple registered projects and one unauthorized or unresolved project.
cases.expected: Per-project identity/freshness preserved; unavailable segment explicit; no global atomic-snapshot or inferred-access claim.

cases.title: Change shadowing gives useful prepared context
cases.setup: Enable a bounded focus, mutate disposable source through a scripted external-agent sequence, then ask a relevant question.
cases.expected: One coalesced relevant preparation is reused or refreshed; answer gives source-backed decision help rather than generic summary.

cases.title: Stable code and self-trigger suppression
cases.setup: Replay no-change polls plus generated notes/logs and an edit burst.
cases.expected: No model calls for unchanged inputs; no note-triggered investigation loop; edit burst coalesces within caps.

cases.title: Persistent quiet and focus expiry
cases.setup: Enable a window, quiet until a time, restart and advance time past both expiries in different orders.
cases.expected: Automatic roots and descendants remain blocked as required; expired focus never resurrects; explicit demand and status behavior remains clear.

cases.title: GPU-release veto prevents rewarming
cases.setup: Release inference, then poll status, deliver change events, restart controller and submit demand.
cases.expected: No automatic reload; demand reports required resume/permission; release veto persists until its declared end.

cases.title: Nonresident conversational UI and grants
cases.setup: Pause at user input and request a scratch action using chat; include instruction-like source data.
cases.expected: No idle model lease; typed trusted controller validates action/grant; source text cannot create authority.

cases.title: Goal relevance and dismissal
cases.setup: Supply a user goal plus conflicting inferred suggestion and repetitive findings.
cases.expected: User goal retains provenance/priority; relevant tradeoff can be surfaced; dismissals and changed focus suppress repeated nagging.

cases.title: Dirty snapshot and canonical sentinel integrity
cases.setup: Materialize tracked dirty and untracked files while an external edit races capture.
cases.expected: Use a consistent captured identity or defer; no reset/clean; canonical files, Git administrative state and Todo unchanged.

cases.title: Sandbox descendants and secrets
cases.setup: Run a disposable test attempting writes outside scratch, forbidden network, sockets, credentials and uncontrolled descendants.
cases.expected: All denied or bounded; missing containment fails closed; no host credential/device leakage.

cases.title: Generate a discriminating unit test
cases.setup: Give the fixture pairing implementation and passing incomplete baseline suite to an experiment.
cases.expected: New scratch odd-tail test exposes the defect with source/test evidence; no automatic canonical repair or claim baseline proves correctness.

cases.title: Negative or inconclusive results are useful
cases.setup: Run a synthetic mechanism comparison that loses or has noisy/failed measurement.
cases.expected: Report applicable negative/inconclusive result and missing evidence; no invented speedup or task promotion.

cases.title: GPU experiment does not wait behind itself
cases.setup: Create an experiment requiring both inference GPU pairs.
cases.expected: Parent suspends and frees inference; controller-leased non-model runner executes; results resume only after experiment release and current power permission.

cases.title: Interrupted effect reconciliation
cases.setup: Crash while a permitted scratch process is active or after artifact write but before result commit.
cases.expected: Reconcile exact process/effect receipt; no blind duplicate execution or partial artifact claimed as completed test.

cases.title: Patch and canonical acceptance remain separate
cases.setup: Produce a valid scratch patch then change canonical source before requesting promotion.
cases.expected: Candidate remains unpromoted; existing explicit parent acceptance detects stale source; no commits, pushes or task completion from scratch.

cases.title: Exact public interface and denied authority
cases.setup: Compare current schema/discovery fixtures and invoke hidden/forbidden operations across profiles.
cases.expected: Observer11, coder12, mutator16 and current semantics preserved unless recorded approved narrow amendment; no public scheduler concepts.

cases.title: Finite grounded model-quality comparison
cases.setup: Run selected direct/multi-hop/conflict/synthesis cases and held-out variants through candidate.
cases.expected: Measured useful complete/partial results, valid evidence, separate reasoning/prefill/tool timings; no winner chosen just for token volume.

cases.title: Assistance economics and foreground interference
cases.setup: Compare equivalent foreground tasks with/without opted-in preparation and background work.
cases.expected: Include preparation/refresh costs, context bytes/tokens, latency spread and sample size; meet predeclared practical envelope or leave feature off.

cases.title: Versioned state and reversible candidate
cases.setup: Exercise quiescent source/runtime transition, old-client isolation and rollback.
cases.expected: No mixed incompatible dispatcher claims or restored old Todo DB; retained evidence/history and explicit disabled automatic work at cutover.

cases.title: Final resource, permission and provenance report
cases.setup: Run applicable acceptance suites and one authorized real lifecycle demonstration.
cases.expected: Tests have nonzero counts, exact source/binary/model identities, actual permitted resource proof, omissions and activation choices; no fixture result relabeled production.

proposed_objectives: Zero model calls for no-change quiet reconciliation.
Zero inference leases held by explicit dependency waits.
No weight-process restart for compatible request-only changes.
No unbounded pending state, artifacts or automatic retry growth.
At least one representative assisted workflow materially helps, with cost and sample limitations reported.
quantitative_threshold_policy: Root and user establish meaningful latency/power/storage envelope before the real comparison. No performance gain is claimed or a threshold retrofitted by this package.
